prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a single wide 16:9 background plate for a handcrafted felt story animation, requested 2048 x 1152.
Primary request: A moonlit wooded country road in Sleepy Hollow, New York, around 1790, represented as a beautiful miniature needle-felt theatrical diorama. One complete coherent landscape image.
Composition: camera at eye height, BROADSIDE view of a road that runs horizontally LEFT TO RIGHT across the image. The usable flat road standing line is at 80 percent of image height, road spans the lower quarter; do NOT make the road disappear toward the horizon. An enormous old gnarled tulip tree stands on the LEFT with pale exposed lightning-scarred wood up its dark knotted trunk and among its branches. Deep woods recede behind. Keep the central 65 percent of the road open with no foreground tree trunks, so animated horse and rider cutouts can pass without their feet being concealed. A distant narrow brook glints at the far right behind the road.
Style: richly handcrafted children's storybook needle-felt wool diorama, visible fuzzy wool fibers, layered fabric leaves and sculpted soft felt trunks, natural irregular handmade shapes. Beautiful cinematic readable set. No realistic photograph.
Lighting: readable silver moonlight on the road and the pale tree scar, rich dark navy blue and teal woods, a few muted ochre autumn leaves. Light atmospheric depth far behind; no dense fog over the road.
Constraints: NO people, NO animals, NO riders, NO ghosts or supernatural entities, NO human faces in trees, NO text, NO lettering, NO logos, NO watermark, NO border, NO collage, NO modern objects, NO snow, NO Christmas decorations. Calm still background, suspenseful but suitable for elementary children. Output one full landscape image.
inspection: Generated result inspected visually: moonlit felt woods, pale scarred old tree at left, clear horizontal road at roughly 75–87% image height, brook right, readable depth, no people animals or text. Copied unchanged.
